strategies.name: ict_aplus_entry_checklist
strategies.direction_note: Longs into discount and shorts into premium are both taught; e.g. the ES 1m/5m examples short into an OTE/premium, the NASDAQ 15m example longs into discount. Verbatim: "I'm looking for a PD array in an OTE or in a premium".

entry_sequence.action: the first thing I focus on is a stop raid this just means that a low was put in before it was rated or broken
the next thing I look for is a market structure shift or displacement this means that a previous high was broken and aggressively moved over
the next thing I look for is where there is a little bit flexibility I generally like to see price move back into a discount of this price range here
the next thing I look for is some sort of PD array where generally I prefer to have a fair value gut or an order block but I will also use an OTE in this area as well as a breaker block

each one of these Concepts could be used as an entry model by themselves however I like to blend one two or three of these Concepts together for my personal strategy for example I will look for a fair value Gap in an optimal trade entry or I'll look for the box set up in an optimal trade entry

confluences.description: the next thing I could look for is a fair value gap which we have a very small one right here
an order block which would be this down close candle right here
breaker block would be these up close candles here before the raid on liquidity
taking that one step further by using an OTE I can see that this is our premium up here where I do not want to be longing and this Narrows down my discount range to my OTE right in here
and lastly for the Box setup I would be looking for price to reach into this area here
confluences.relaxation_note: although we did not shift structure prior to this entry this is a box setup entry and I wanted to throw it in here just to show that without a lower time frame liquidity rate prior to a move I am not interested in it

stop.long_words: putting my stop on this order block low
stop.short_words: my stop on the order block High
stop.break_even_words: depending on if I move my stop to break even

targets.description: then looking for buy side liquidity up here
if I was too partial and reach for those lows I talked about earlier
your target the initial highs from the morning and from there let runners run

partials.first_partial_words: My Stop on this low first partial here

instrument_classification.note: ICT price-action entry method demonstrated on NASDAQ (NQ) and ES index futures across daily/hourly/15m/5m/1m; no options Greeks or strikes — a price/structure mechanic, not an options mechanic.

coverage_notes: All 5 inventoried PD-array variants APPEAR in the extraction, each in the speaker's words: (1) FVG PD-array variant — APPEARS ("a fair value gap which we have a very small one right here"; also intro line "I prefer to have a fair value gut"). (2) order block variant — APPEARS ("an order block which would be this down close candle right here"; short example "my entry would be on this order block ... my stop on the order block High"). (3) breaker block variant — APPEARS ("breaker block would be these up close candles here before the raid on liquidity"; 2nd example "this breaker block ... price return to this breaker block"). (4) OTE fib-refinement variant — APPEARS ("by using an OTE ... this Narrows down my discount range to my OTE right in here"). (5) box setup variant (relaxes structure-shift requirement) — APPEARS, and the relaxation is explicitly taught: "although we did not shift structure prior to this entry this is a box setup entry ... without a lower time frame liquidity rate prior to a move I am not interested in it" — confirming the box setup drops the structure-shift precondition but still requires a prior liquidity raid. STOP was explicitly taught and is extracted verbatim, NOT nulled: "putting my stop on this order block low" (long), "my stop on the order block High" (short), plus optional break-even "depending on if I move my stop to break even". Blending is taught ("blend one two or three of these Concepts together"). Note: the transcript renders 'fair value gap' as 'fair value gut' and 'shift in structure' as 'fifth instructor' in the intro/ES sections (ASR artifacts); cleaner verbatim occurrences were selected for grounding where available.
